tasks.notes: experiments/fgpl_seed/roundtrip.py: fgpl_export gated seed (tau=0.10) -> FGPL real estimator on the 6-room area3_seed_ablation subset -> score vs S3DIS GT next to cached oracle/p1. RESULT: plumbing PROVEN (10/10 localized, 0 errors); per-room coverage 6/6; right-room trans median 1.048m vs oracle 0.696 vs p1 0.998 (low-pct median ~tied p1 at n=10 = marginal, D31/D23 per-pano ceiling; win is coverage+tail); wrong-room 2/10 (coverage survives -> why per-ROOM is the metric); rotation ~105deg = FGPL Manhattan-aliasing (oracle 89.9deg), not PanoPin. Also served as the deferred D34 tau precision check THROUGH FGPL. Spec/plan docs/{specs,plans}/2026-07-15-fgpl-roundtrip*. Merged to main + pushed (bfb8fce). Caveats: Area_3 subset only; oracle/p1 ref used 12-pano Voronoi vs 10 here (reference, not controlled).
